useCases: Agora helps international students in Germany find part-time work. We use Claude to draft tailored CVs and cover letters from a student's own profile and a chosen job ad, summarise CVs into structured skills, explain why a job matched, and generate interview practice questions. Output is shown only to the student who requested it. They review and edit every document and click apply themselves - we never auto-submit applications, and we never train models on user data. EU-hosted, GDPR compliant.
